source_definition: The source is a connected graph containing no induced disjoint union of three edges. Its outputs are nontrivial cuts with crossing degree at most two, or NO-SOLUTION.
target_definition: Both endpoints are connected simple graphs and seek a nontrivial bipartition with at most two opposite neighbors per vertex. The source excludes three disjoint induced edges; the target excludes an induced six-vertex path.
required_result: Construct deterministic polynomial-time maps F and G: F sends every legal source instance to a legal target instance, and G(x,y) is a valid source output for every valid output y of F(x). Preserve the stated threshold, domain and promises. The requested complexity conclusion is NP-hardness for the stated target problem.
